scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && npm run build -w functions
scripts.deploy:demo-preview: npm run build:demo-preview && firebase hosting:channel:deploy design-preview --project kagomeet --expires 7d
scripts.setup:emulators: node scripts/setup-emulators.mjs && npm run build -w functions
scripts.test:integration: npm run setup:emulators && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-kagomeet --only auth,firestore,functions,storage 'node scripts/run-integration.mjs'
scripts.build:production: npm run check:production && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run build:production && firebase deploy --project kagomeet
scripts.format: prettier --write src functions/src tests scripts docs *.json *.ts README.md
